$dynamic¶

Molecular dynamics with a thermostat.

Relevant when: task = thermostat

Known only from the official example inputs and a third-party input generator. Every meaning below is inferred, except file.

In version 25, task=thermostat with e=0.001 d=0.03 n=20,5 m=10 i=1 ran with every tested theory (dft, ridft, rimp2, ccsd, tddft, qm_n3). The output has one line per step, point N: s … E … g …, where negative point numbers are equilibration steps (the second value of n) and positive ones the production steps (the first value). In the program, d and h are prefixes of the keywords dx and hb.

$dynamic
 e=0.001
 d=0.03
 n=1000,100
 m=10
 i=1
 file=H40C20/H40C20_%06d.qm.in
$end

e¶

Type: real
Default: none stated
Units: hartree
Status: undocumented · not verified
Sources: 01 §4.8; 02 §3.2

Thermostat temperature as kT (inferred: a generator script sets e = T/315775).

d¶

Type: real
Default: none stated
Status: undocumented · not verified
Sources: 01 §4.8; 02 §3.2

Time step (inferred).

n¶

Type: list
Default: none stated
Status: undocumented · not verified
Sources: 01 §4.8; 02 §3.2

Number of steps and print interval (inferred).

m¶

Type: integer
Default: none stated
Status: undocumented · not verified
Sources: 01 §4.8; 02 §3.2

Meaning not known.

i¶

Type: integer
Default: none stated
Status: undocumented · not verified
Sources: 01 §4.8; 02 §3.2

Run index or random seed (inferred).

v¶

Type: real
Default: none stated
Units: bohr³ per atom
Status: undocumented · not verified
Sources: 01 §4.8; 02 §3.2

Volume per atom of a spherical confining cavity, e.g. for simulating a liquid (inferred).

h¶

Type: real
Default: none stated
Status: undocumented · not verified
Sources: 01 §4.8; 02 §3.2

Stiffness of the cavity wall (inferred).

file¶

Type: string
Default: none stated
Status: undocumented · not verified
Sources: 01 §4.8

printf-style pattern for snapshot files, which are written as ready-to-run inputs; %06d is the frame number.
